answers.3: There is no text, number, arrow, label or symbol anywhere in the picture.
answers.4: Someone might read the pink bulge behind the ear as a growing tumour or an abscess, rather than a simple swelling or normal bony shape.

observers.label: Caption-blind observer 2 (Claude)

answers.1: A man's head and upper neck seen from behind and slightly to the side, so the right ear, jawline and part of the cheek and eyelashes show. Hair is long on top, shaved short on the sides and back.
answers.2: The skin is drawn smooth and even in colour, with no cuts, rash or scabs. Just behind and above the ear, on the bare shaved scalp, there is a rounded, egg-shaped bulge tinted pink, sitting under the skin rather than on top of it. Curving along the crease where the ear meets the head is a thin pale band with a darker outline, hooking over the top of the ear and ending near the earlobe — it could be a slim behind-the-ear device (like a hearing aid) or simply the shaded edge of the swelling; I am unsure which. A soft pink blush spreads on the skin just below and behind the ear. Nothing else is worn; no dressing, tape or cream is shown.
answers.3: There is no text, number, arrow, label or symbol anywhere in the picture. The background is plain off-white.
answers.4: A worried person might read the pink lump behind the ear as a growing tumour or an infected, swollen gland, rather than a device sitting behind the ear.
